collection.title: BMW 3 Series Touring 1987 to 1994 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 1987 to 1994 version of a BMW 3 Series Touring requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
